description: This Java class LogWrapper implements a logging utility that wraps Android's native Log class, allowing for customizable log output and chaining through LogNode interface. It primarily forwards log messages to Android’s Log and optionally to a next node in the logging chain.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility implementing the LogNode interface, enabling chaining of log outputs and forwarding logs to subsequent nodes.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list for chaining log outputs.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to receive log data after this node.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable. It forwards the log to Android's Log and to the next node if available.
